_comment: Structures are placed with the Construction Tool and paid for out of your
bag at the moment you place them. They are NOT crafted: no structure ever
exists as an item in your inventory, there is no recipe for one, and no
workbench is involved. Only items are fabricated.
That distinction was got wrong once and it broke the opening of the game.
Structures were craftable items you 'deployed', so the Sub-Fief needed a
Survival Fabricator to make it -- which put a late-game bench, built from
refined metal, in the first five minutes and made the first claim
impossible to stake. Keeping the two catalogues apart is what stops that
class of mistake: if it is in this file it is placed, if it is in
kind      'piece'   snaps to the claim's build grid (BuildGrid)
'station' stands on a foundation and does work (StationField)
needs     'foundation' -- must sit on a foundation you have already laid.
Everything except the foundation itself and the Sub-Fief does.
open      may go down outside any claim. Only the Sub-Fief may, because it
is the thing that creates a claim in the first place.
category  the tab it appears under in the build palette.

structures.name: Sub-Fief Console
structures.desc: Registers a holding: a 48 m box of ground and air, and the only ground your Construction Tool will work on. The first thing you place, and the only thing you may place on open desert.

structures.name: Foundation
structures.desc: A cube of dressed granite sunk into the ground so only its lid shows. Everything else in your holding stands on these.

structures.name: Wall
structures.desc: Goes up on the edge of a floor tile. Breaks the wind and the sightline; there are no doors.

structures.name: Ceiling
structures.desc: Caps a room, and becomes the floor of the storey above -- which is the whole of the multi-storey rule.

structures.name: Ore Refinery
structures.desc: Cooks ore down into ingots. Built from scrap and stone, because it is what every refined material in the game comes through -- nothing above it could exist if it needed refining itself.

structures.name: Survival Fabricator
structures.desc: The workbench proper. Comes after the refinery, not before it: the ingots in it are refinery work, so a standing holding with a refinery on it is the price of admission.

structures.name: Windtrap
structures.desc: Wrings water out of the night air and fills a cistern with it. Turns water from a per-trip crisis into infrastructure.

structures.name: Water Cistern
structures.desc: Somewhere for a windtrap to put what it catches, and somewhere for you to draw it back out.

structures.name: Storage Chest
structures.desc: Twenty slots that stay where you left them.

structures.name: Fuel Generator
structures.desc: Burns fuel cells for power. Reliable, and it costs you something every hour it runs.

structures.name: Wind Turbine
structures.desc: Free power when the wind is up, and nothing when it is not.
